BiblicalUsage: Adoraim was one of the cities Rehoboam fortified after the kingdom split — a fenced city in Judah, stocked with food, oil, wine, shields, and spears. It appears only once, in the list of fifteen cities Rehoboam strengthened to hold what was left of his kingdom; the place itself is covered in the Biblical Places collection.
TheologicalSignificance: A fortified town in a list carries no doctrine, and I won't invent one. Its story is the story of a kingdom shrinking: Rehoboam could wall his cities, but no wall could give back the ten tribes he had lost.
